title: Sample-Specific Output Constraints for Neural Networks

title: Probabilistic Forecasting Cryptocurrencies Volatility: From Point to Quantile Forecasts
known_mechanism: QRS residual simulation, quantile linear regression and quantile regression forests over point forecasts.
difference_and_limit: E3 is a point model of centered rolling seven-return sigma, with a deterministic sample-dependent floor. The paper’s quantiles are a separate meta-forecasting layer. Preprint v1; no exact finite-atom U-to-sigma pushforward mechanism is identified in the examined sections. That absence is bounded, not global.
consequence: Adding quantiles or probabilistic forecasts in crypto is not by itself new; a future law-based head needs a much narrower algorithmic distinction.

locator_reused: §4 Definitions 4.1–4.3, Eqs.(1)–(2); §4.1 conditional output-constrained priors; §4.2 approximate inference.
